# Offline Observation Requirements Checklist: Offline Field Observation Capture

**Purpose**: Review the clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability of SPEC-010's offline capture, authorization, retry, and reconciliation requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `$speckit-checklist` from the current specification and planning artifacts.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only after a reviewer judges the written criterion satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` records requirements-quality review, not implementation completion.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the prerequisites for saving a Field and optional Season observation context defined, including the authorized source, account binding, and Business timezone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for creating a *new* note after offline restart when the original account is identifiable but sign-in cannot refresh? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for both existing pending-note recovery and new-note capture after restart, without implying access to arbitrary Fields or Seasons? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK004 Are all values required for an exact retry explicitly named, including stable identity, canonical text, occurrence instant, local-time representation, and Field/Season association? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Are local command lifecycle states and their farmer-facing meanings specified for pending, uncertain, accepted, and needs-attention outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the condition for identifying the original account after an offline restart clear enough to distinguish it from a merely stored former account ID? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 Is the difference between a locally captured note and a server-accepted observation stated without implying that local capture grants access? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 Is the phrase “earlier attempt may have committed” defined precisely enough to classify a first definitive denial versus a denial after a lost response or process crash? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK009 Is the fate of the original note after a definitive validation, association, or identity conflict clear, including whether any subsequent attempt can reuse its unchanged identity and payload? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK010 Is the distinction between an authenticated session and locally identifiable account context clear for both capture and delivery? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are account-scoped offline capture, explicit sign-out/account-switch hiding, and later original-account recovery requirements mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, §FR-001, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK012 Do the preserved SPEC-006 Business-timezone rules align with exact unchanged retry when the Business timezone changes between capture, acceptance, and replay? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK013 Are “not accepted,” “unconfirmed,” and “accepted” used consistently across scenarios, requirements, and measurable outcomes? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, §FR-010, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK014 Do the no-duplicate diary requirement and existing diary pagination/order requirement permit one clear interpretation of when a local accepted result can be retired? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK015 Are the spec's scope exclusions consistent with the plan's proposed account/context persistence and observation-specific command boundary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Summary]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can restart durability be judged from the stated criteria without relying on an unspecified meaning of “recoverable”? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK017 Is “one logical observation” defined well enough to judge duplicate prevention across rapid confirmation, lost response, replay, and diary reconciliation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK018 Do the authorization criteria distinguish “this rejected attempt created nothing” from the possibility that an earlier uncertain attempt already committed? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK019 Are the success criteria sufficient to judge offline capture while sign-in cannot refresh and to confirm that server delivery waits for restored authorization? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are primary, alternate, exception, and recovery requirements present for local save failure, offline restart, reconnect, uncertain response, and later authorized reconciliation? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–3]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for a process crash during submission, where the server outcome is unknown but the local command must survive? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a lost acceptance response followed by membership revocation, without a privacy-breaking canonical lookup or false rejection? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for a Field rename, Season change, or timezone change before first delivery without silently rebasing the original command? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK024 Are the requirements clear when a canonical diary refresh fails or the accepted observation is outside the first paginated page? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK025 Are DST gap/fold, future-time, empty-text, and overlong-text boundaries specified for local capture and current server acceptance? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, §User Story 1]

## Security, Privacy, and Accessibility Requirements

- [x] CHK026 Are local text/context visibility rules specified for signed-out, switched-account, unidentified-account, and revoked-membership cases? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK027 Are current membership, Business, Field, Season, and actor checks specified for both first create and idempotent replay? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK028 Are authorization error requirements privacy-safe while retaining the original farmer-authored note locally? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK029 Are distinct status text and accessibility announcements required for pending, retrying, unconfirmed, denied/conflicted, accepted, and diary-refresh failure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Boundaries

- [x] CHK030 Are the dependencies on SPEC-001/003/005/006 separated from capabilities this feature newly requires, particularly offline account identification and saved observation context? [Dependency, Spec §Dependencies, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK031 Is it explicit that the existing canonical observation and diary remain authoritative, while the new local command state is neither canonical history nor generic sync? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK032 Are all frozen exclusions stated without accidentally ruling out the narrow persistence needed for approved offline restart capture? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-014]

## Notes

- Review the written requirements and planning decisions; do not use these checkboxes as implementation test results.
- Leave items unchecked when they require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation. `$speckit-implement` reads custom checklist state but does not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` follows a separate built-in checklist lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
